kind: Complete measured 15-input review selection; all selected inputs tie at zero quality improvement.
policy: Sum supported chosen-class scores divided by their frozen review levels across both profiles; relative reduction of that sum. A measured stable zero remains zero. Sort decreasing reduction, then original manifest order; first ten and last five fill the required distinct slots.
